description.en: We could not travel much farther in the vehicle, parked, and continued on foot around 1910. Around 1918 we saw a large red orb at a further distance, facing North and slightly West, past the peak of [redacted]. I am certain I saw two red, smaller orbs release from the larger one going west, towards [redacted]. One released at a steady speed and horizontally. I also saw another small red orb go up, but it may have had a slight angle. This orb was fainter, than the horizontal one identified. They were simultaneously released, moving away from the larger orb. The larger orb did not move during this time, and all lights were gone from every orb in about 10 seconds. Either while the lights were on, or shortly after they were out of sight, we saw a white flash of light in the sky to the West.
description.fr: Nous ne pouvions guère aller plus loin en voiture ; nous nous sommes garés et avons continué à pied vers 19 h 10. Vers 19 h 18, nous avons vu une grande orbe rouge plus lointaine, face au nord et légèrement à l'ouest, au-delà du pic de [caviardé]. Je suis certain d'avoir vu deux orbes rouges plus petites s'en détacher vers l'ouest, vers [caviardé]. L'une partait à vitesse constante, à l'horizontale. J'ai aussi vu une autre petite orbe rouge monter, peut-être un peu en biais ; elle était plus faible que l'horizontale. Elles se sont détachées en même temps, en s'éloignant de la grande. La grande orbe n'a pas bougé, et toutes les lumières se sont éteintes en une dizaine de secondes. Pendant ou peu après, nous avons vu un éclair blanc dans le ciel à l'ouest.

time.rationale: the second of the two evenings (witness 1: "The second night"), taken as 2023-10-15: the one evening of October 2023 with a freshly launched Starlink train to the south-east between 7 and 9 pm, as witness 4 saw on his second evening; "Around 1918"

durationSeconds.rationale: "all lights were gone from every orb in about 10 seconds", then the flash

value.name: White Rock Road, Desert National Wildlife Refuge, Nevada

place.rationale: the place is withheld ("a sensitive national security site in the western United States"). Working hypothesis of RR0: the Nevada National Security Site, over which drones were detected on three days in October 2023 (Wall Street Journal), and the Desert National Wildlife Refuge north of Las Vegas; witness 5 turned off a highway towards a "Wildlife National park (?name)" onto a rough unpaved road, and saw the light "ahead and slightly to our right" over "a distinctive peak in the ridge line", which AARO measured at about 1,050 m. White Rock Road in the refuge, driven west, has a peak on the skyline 1,090 m away ahead and to the right (bearing 321, 5.5° high), found by a search of the 10 m USGS relief for summits standing out 0.9 to 1.3 km from the refuge's tracks; one candidate among several; they had walked on a little: the same place is kept
